full_page.content:
1935, January 29
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten postcard by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. (from the photo copy)
ST. BONAVENTURE MONASTERY 1740 Mt. Elliott Avenue Detroit, Michigan January 29, 2935
Miss Gibson Mercy Hall 103 Eliot St. City
Dear Miss Gibson:
I am sending you Miss Bergta Habib. She seems to think she'd probably like to share your labors-
Your crown to as I hope.
Sincerely yours in the Sacred Heart,
Fr. Solanus Casey, O. M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Mrs. Bergita Habib Nahas 20435 15 Mile Rd. Mt. Clemens, Mi. 48043
